description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
When Kitchen Finks enters, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
